newsitem.title: LATVIA: OLAINFARM PROFIT 495,101 LATS IN LAST QUARTER.
newsitem.headline: OLAINFARM PROFIT 495,101 LATS IN LAST QUARTER.

text.p: Olainfarm on Thursday said that its after-tax profit in the first three months of its current financial year came to 495,101 lats on net turnover of 1.64 million lats.
"Our after-tax profit for last three months is 495,671 lats and we hope to show even better results later in the year," Egils Jurshevics, Olainfarm board chairman, told Reuters.
Olainfarm's current financial year dates from April 1.
"Because of the seasonal character of our business, with better sales in winter, we have good grounds to believe that the figures later in 1997 will be even better," Jurshevics said.
The company also plans to boost its statutory capital in autumn of this year through a new share issue.
"Given that the controlling stake owner (Olmafarm) has to invest two million lats in two years' time, we might consider a boost close to the size of this sum," Jurshevics said.
The decision about the size of the capital booost should be taken by an extraordinary shareholder's meeting on August 23, Jurshevics said.
The company's total assets came to 7.33 million lats and fixed assets were worth 4.49 million lats Jurshevics, said.
Olainfarm has payments due worth 3.22 million lats and has long-term liabilities of 2.2 million lats and 6.14 million lats of short-term liabilities.
